name: Contact Form Extender for Divi Builder
author: Satinder Singh

sections.description:
Contact Form Extender for Divi Builder extends the default Divi contact form module with useful extra features.

This plugin helps you:

  • Add file upload field to Divi contact form
  • Save contact form submissions in database
  • Manage form entries easily from WordPress

More advanced features will be added in future updates.

Use of 3rd Party Services

To improve plugin performance and user experience, this plugin may collect optional feedback and limited diagnostic information. Such data is transmitted only after explicit user consent to the Cool Plugins internal Feedback Server. Any data shared is strictly optional and can be skipped. Details about what information may be collected and how it is used are available in our Usage Tracking Policy.

The plugin does not perform hidden tracking or collect data without user approval. Further details are available in our Terms of Service, and Privacy Policy.

The plugin also contains an optional link to Trustpilot for public reviews. No data is automatically transmitted to Trustpilot.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Use the Divi Contact Form module as usual.
  4. Extra features will be available automatically.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with Divi Builder?

Yes, this plugin works with the Divi Contact Form module.

Does it save form submissions in database?

Yes, submitted form entries are saved in the WordPress database.

Is file upload supported?

Yes, you can add a file upload field to the Divi contact form.
